title: Umutima Ubabazwa wo ku Ruzi Nili
intro: Mu gihe c’agahahazo gakomeye, igihe umunyagitugu yatwara igihugu n’ububisha burengeye urugero, umutima umwe warahisemwo inzira y’ukwizera aho guhitamwo ihumure ry’ubwami. Uwo mubare wari mu mutima w’ububasha yamara usanga ukuri mu butumwa bw’umuhanuzi yicisha bugufi. Urugendo rwabo rwocitse icigwa kidahera co kwihangana, kwitanga no kwemera kudahungabana. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo muntu adasanzwe yahisemwo umunezero uva ku Mana kuruta ikibanza co mw’isi?
clues: Nabaye mu ngoro y’ububasha bukomeye, yamara umutima wanje wararonse ukuri mu butumwa bwicishije bugufi.
Nahisemwo gukurikiza ubuyobozi bwa Musa, nzi ingaruka nari guhura na zo.
Narongowe n’umunyagitugu akomeye kuruta abandi bose bo mu gihe canje, yamara naranse imana ziwe z’ikinyoma.
Imibabaro yanje yari myinshi cane, kuko nahanwa kubera ukwemera kwanje Imana imwe.
Sinigeze ncika intege mu kwizera kwanje, mbere n’igihe nashikiwe n’imibabaro ikaze kuruta izindi zose.
Umukama wanje yaranezerewe n’ukwihangana kwanje, aca antora ikibanza c’icubahiro muri Paradizo.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kurwana mu nzira ya Allah n'ingabo
Guhangana na Farawoni no kumenyesha ukwizera .
Kubaka ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo mu Misiri .
trial.answer: Guhangana na Farawoni no kumenyesha ukwizera .

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
